idea: How to detect a leaking toilet
title: Finding Silent Toilet Leaks Before They Spike Your Water Bill
description: A silent toilet leak can waste hundreds of gallons of water each day without making a sound. To test your toilet, remove the tank lid and place several drops of dark food coloring directly into the water inside the cistern. Do not flush. Wait 15 to 20 minutes without using the toilet. If the colored water appears in the toilet bowl, your flapper or flush valve seal is worn out and allowing water to seep through continuously. Replacing a faulty flapper is often a straightforward fix, but if the leak persists or the fill valve runs constantly, consult a licensed plumber to inspect the fixture.
